addJoin(bytes6,address).details: Add a new Join for an Asset, or replace an existing one for a new one. There can be only one Join per Asset. Until a Join is added, no tokens of that Asset can be posted or withdrawn.

addPool(bytes6,address).details: Add a new Pool for a Series, or replace an existing one for a new one. There can be only one Pool per Series. Until a Pool is added, it is not possible to borrow Base.

addToken(address,bool).details: Add or remove a token that the Ladle can call `transfer` or `permit` on.

batch(bytes[]).details: Allows batched call to self (this contract).

params.calls: An array of inputs for each call.

build(bytes6,bytes6,uint8).details: Create a new vault, linked to a series (and therefore underlying) and a collateral

close(bytes12,address,int128,int128).details: Repay vault debt using underlying token at a 1:1 exchange rate, without trading in a pool. It can add or remove collateral at the same time. The debt to repay is denominated in fyToken, even if the tokens pulled from the user are underlying. The debt to repay must be entered as a negative number, as with `pour`. Debt cannot be acquired with this function.

closeFromLadle(bytes12,address).details: Use base in the Ladle to repay debt. Return unused base to `to`. Return as much collateral as debt was repaid, as well. This function is only used when removing liquidity added with "Borrow and Pool", so it's safe to assume the exchange rate is 1:1. If used in other contexts, it might revert, which is fine.

destroy(bytes12).details: Destroy an empty vault. Used to recover gas costs.

exitEther(address).details: Unwrap Wrapped Ether held by this Ladle, and send the Ether This function should be called last in a batch, and the Ladle should have no reason to keep an WETH balance

forwardDaiPermit(address,address,uint256.details: Execute a Dai-style permit for the selected token

forwardPermit(address,address,uint256,ui.details: Execute an ERC2612 permit for the selected token

give(bytes12,address).details: Give a vault to another user.

joinEther(bytes6).details: Accept Ether, wrap it and forward it to the WethJoin This function should be called first in a batch, and the Join should keep track of stored reserves Passing the id for a join that doesn't link to a contract implemnting IWETH9 will fail

moduleCall(address,bytes).details: Allow users to use functionality coded in a module, to be used with batch

pour(bytes12,address,int128,int128).details: Add collateral and borrow from vault, pull assets from and push borrowed asset to user Or, repay to vault and remove collateral, pull borrowed asset from and push assets to user Borrow only before maturity.

redeem(bytes6,address,uint256).details: Allow users to redeem fyToken, to be used with batch. If 0 is passed as the amount to redeem, it redeems the fyToken balance of the Ladle instead.

repay(bytes12,address,int128,uint128).details: Repay debt by selling base in a pool and using the resulting fyToken The base tokens need to be already in the pool, unaccounted for. Only before maturity. After maturity use close.

repayFromLadle(bytes12,address).details: Use fyToken in the Ladle to repay debt. Return unused fyToken to `to`. Return as much collateral as debt was repaid, as well. This function is only used when removing liquidity added with "Borrow and Pool", so it's safe to assume the exchange rate is 1:1. If used in other contexts, it might revert, which is fine.

repayVault(bytes12,address,int128,uint12.details: Repay all debt in a vault by buying fyToken from a pool with base. The base tokens need to be already in the pool, unaccounted for. The surplus base will be returned to msg.sender. Only before maturity. After maturity use close.

retrieve(address,address).details: Retrieve any token in the Ladle

roll(bytes12,bytes6,uint8,uint128).details: Change series and debt of a vault.

route(address,bytes).details: Allow users to route calls to a contract, to be used with batch

serve(bytes12,address,uint128,uint128,ui.details: Add collateral and borrow from vault, so that a precise amount of base is obtained by the user. The base is obtained by borrowing fyToken and buying base with it in a pool. Only before maturity.

stir(bytes12,bytes12,uint128,uint128).details: Move collateral and debt between vaults.

transfer(address,address,uint128).details: Allow users to trigger a token transfer from themselves to a receiver through the ladle, to be used with batch

tweak(bytes12,bytes6,bytes6).details: Change a vault series or collateral.

addModule(address,bool).notice: Treat modules as you would Ladle upgrades. Modules have unrestricted access to the Ladle storage, and can wreak havoc easily. Modules must not do any changes to any vault (owner, seriesId, ilkId) because of vault caching. Modules must not be contracts that can self-destruct because of `moduleCall`. Modules can't use `msg.value` because of `batch`.
